name: The Needy
overview: Scripture clearly commands believers to generously support the needy, recognizing that poverty will persist in the land and calling for open hands toward brothers and sisters in need (Deuteronomy 15:11). Honoring God involves showing mercy to the poor, as oppressing them is a reproach to the Creator (Proverbs 14:31). Giving to the needy is portrayed as lending to the Lord Himself, who promises to repay such acts of compassion (Proverbs 19:17), and those who give bountifully will be blessed (Proverbs 22:9). Conversely, withholding help brings curses, while generous giving secures lasting treasure in heaven beyond earthly loss or decay (Proverbs 28:27; Luke 12:33).
